events.description: Two gladiators engage in close-quarters combat in an arena: one (Maximus) wields a sword and shield, the other wears a helmet and armor; they exchange blows, parry, and grapple across multiple frames.

Two gladiators engage in a sword fight in an arena; one is wounded (visible at f2), they grapple and exchange blows, culminating in one delivering a decisive strike (f10–f11) and the opponent falling (f13–f14).

A sustained gladiatorial combat sequence in an arena: two armored fighters engage in close-quarters sword and axe combat, with dynamic exchanges, parries, strikes, and one fighter delivering a visible wound to the other's torso.

Two gladiators engage in close-quarters sword combat in an arena; the protagonist (in leather armor) parries and strikes against an opponent in full metal armor with a helmet, while dust rises from impacts.
The protagonist delivers a decisive blow to the armored opponent, causing visible injury (blood on torso) and forcing the opponent backward; the fight remains active and mutual.
After the strike, the protagonist disengages slightly, repositions, and prepares for the next exchange while the opponent recovers; combat continues with both fighters actively engaged and mobile.

Two gladiators engage in close-quarters combat: the armored opponent with a horned helmet attacks with a short weapon while the protagonist (Maximus) defends and maneuvers, as seen in frames f0–f7 showing dynamic positioning, weapon contact, and evasive movement.

The horned-helmet gladiator executes a high swing with a bladed weapon (likely a sica), while Maximus is positioned to parry or evade; frames f13–f15 show the attack motion and defensive posture, confirming active mutual combat.

A decisive strike occurs: Maximus swings his sword, generating dust and impact, as the opponent recoils—frame f8 shows the sword mid-swing with visible dust cloud, indicating forceful contact or near-contact in combat.
